courses.subject: CNGT
courses.title: Prenatal and Adult Genetics
courses.description:
Part 1 - Prenatal Genetics
The course deals with prenatal dysmorphology and genetic syndromes. It will also cover the principles of prenatal screening and diagnosis with emphasis on screening for Down syndrome and other fetal aneuploidies.

Part 2 - Adult Genetics
The course covers the diagnosis, counseling and management of late onset genetic diseases. It includes BRCA1/2, hereditary colon cancer, cancer genetic syndromes I (Haemat), cancer genetic syndromes, DNA breakage disorders, Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, Marfan syndrome & related disorders, hereditary cardiomyopathy and cardiac conductions defects, neurodegeneration (Parkinson, Alzheimer, & related disorders), hereditary sensory motor neuropathies, genes and hearing, hereditary sensory motor neuropathies, head and neck region with some peripheral neuropathies, triplet repeat disorders in adults and mitochondrial disorders.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Medical Genetics
courses.learning_outcomes: Students are expected to acquire up-to-date knowledge on prenatal and adult genetics in advanced level.
